summary: This table presents key employee metrics for a company over three quarters ending on March 31, 2025, December 31, 2024, and March 31, 2024. It includes total employees, software professionals, sales and support staff, voluntary attrition percentage, and the percentage of women employees. Notably, total employees increased from 317,240 in March 2024 to 323,578 in March 2025, while the voluntary attrition percentage rose from 12.6% to 14.1% during the same period. The percentage of women employees remained relatively stable at around 39%.
